verses.pali: ตัส์มา หิ เน รักขะถะ อัปปะมัตตา.
verses.english: therefore protect them, being diligent.

verses.pali: ยังกิญจิ วิตตัง อิธะ วา หุรัง วา
verses.pali_roman: Yaṅkiñci vittaṃ idha vā huraṃ vā
verses.english: Whatever treasure there is, here or beyond,

verses.pali: สัคเคสุ วา ยัง ระตะนัง ปะณีตัง
verses.english: or whatever excellent jewel is in the heavens,

verses.pali: นะ โน สะมัง อัตถิ ตะถาคะเตนะ
verses.english: there is none among them equal to the Tathāgata.

verses.pali: อิทัมปิ พุทเธ ระตะนัง ปะณีตัง.
verses.english: This too is an excellent jewel in the Buddha.

verses.pali: เอเตนะ สัจเจนะ สุวัตถิ โหตุ.
verses.english: By this truth, may there be well-being.

verses.pali: ขะยัง วิราคัง อะมะตัง ปะณีตัง
verses.english: The destruction, the fading of desire, the deathless, the excellent —

verses.pali: ยะทัชฌะคา สัก์ยะมุนี สะมาหิโต
verses.english: which the Sakyan sage, composed, attained;

verses.pali: นะ เตนะ ธัมเมนะ สะมัตถิ กิญจิ
verses.english: there is nothing at all equal to that Dhamma.

verses.pali: อิทัมปิ ธัมเม ระตะนัง ปะณีตัง
verses.english: This too is an excellent jewel in the Dhamma.

verses.pali: เอเตนะ สัจเจนะ สุวัตถิ โหตุ.
verses.english: By this truth, may there be well-being.

verses.pali: ยัมพุทธะเสฏโฐ ปะริวัณณะยี สุจิง
verses.english: That purity which the supreme Buddha praised,

verses.pali: สะมาธิมานันตะริกัญญะมาหุ
verses.english: the concentration they call 'without interval' —

verses.pali: สะมาธินา เตนะ สะโม นะ วิชชะติ
verses.english: no concentration equal to that is found.

verses.pali: อิทัมปิ ธัมเม ระตะนัง ปะณีตัง
verses.english: This too is an excellent jewel in the Dhamma.

verses.pali: เอเตนะ สัจเจนะ สุวัตถิ โหตุ.
verses.english: By this truth, may there be well-being.

verses.pali: เย ปุคคะลา อัฏฐะ สะตัง ปะสัตถา
verses.english: Those eight persons praised by the good,

verses.pali: จัตตาริ เอตานิ ยุคานิ โหนติ
verses.english: who make these four pairs;

verses.pali: เต ทักขิเณยยา สุคะตัสสะ สาวะกา
verses.english: they are the Well-gone One's disciples, worthy of offerings;

verses.pali: เอเตสุ ทินนานิ มะหัปผะลานิ
verses.english: what is given to them bears great fruit.

verses.pali: อิทัมปิ สังเฆ ระตะนัง ปะณีตัง
verses.english: This too is an excellent jewel in the Saṅgha.

verses.pali: เอเตนะ สัจเจนะ สุวัตถิ โหตุ.
verses.english: By this truth, may there be well-being.

verses.pali: เย สุปปะยุตตา มะนะสา ทัฬ์เหนะ
verses.english: Those who, with a firm mind, are well applied

verses.pali: นิกกามิโน โคตะมะสาสะนัมหิ
verses.english: and free of longing, in Gotama's dispensation;

verses.pali: เต ปัตติปัตตา อะมะตัง วิคัยหะ
verses.english: they have reached the attainment, plunged into the deathless,

verses.pali: ลัทธา มุธา นิพพุติง ภุญชะมานา
verses.english: and having gained it for nothing, enjoy the peace;

vocabulary.meaning: a jewel. The sutta's whole structure: each stanza names one and swears well-being on the truth of it

vocabulary.pali: เอเตนะ สัจเจนะ สุวัตถิ โหตุ
vocabulary.meaning: 'by this truth, may there be well-being' — an act of truth, where the protection rests on the statement being true rather than on any power in the words

vocabulary.pali: อานันตะริกะสะมาธิ
vocabulary.meaning: the concentration 'without interval' — the samādhi immediately followed by its fruit, which verse 20 says has no equal

vocabulary.pali: อัฏฐะ ปุคคะลา / จัตตาริ ยุคานิ
vocabulary.meaning: the eight persons who are four pairs — the four stages of awakening counted as path and fruit

vocabulary.pali: ทักขิเณยยะ
vocabulary.meaning: worthy of offerings. Why giving to the Saṅgha is said to bear great fruit
for nothing, without cost. The peace is not bought — it is had freely by those who reached it

checks.issue: ทัฬ์เหนะ IS RECORDED WITH ฬ, AND THE PHOTOGRAPH CANNOT SHOW THAT — this is the exact configuration page 76 proved unreadable. The letter carries the ์ cluster mark, and page 76 demonstrated on one sheet that a MARKED ฬ์ loses its ascender in this printing and is indistinguishable from พ์: อาสาฬหบูชา bare showed its ascender plainly at 8x while อาสาฬ์หะ eleven lines above did not. Josh settled that word as ฬ from the book. The deciding test here is the one page 79 added: พ์ + ห IS NOT A LEGAL PALI CLUSTER, so reading พ gives dabhena, which is not a word, while ฬ gives daḷhena — firm, resolute — which is what manasā daḷhena means. Recorded as ฬ on the cluster test, NOT on the image. Worth Josh's eye with the book, like every marked ฬ์ from here on.

SINGLE COLUMN, MEASURED, AND THE SETTING DID NOT CARRY OVER. Ink runs x 620 to x 1400 across all twenty-six lines with no empty band inside it. Page 82 had this same chant sitting beneath two two-column chants, so the eye wants to carry the two-column reading across the page turn. Profiled fresh.

FIVE STANZA OPENINGS, MEASURED RATHER THAN JUDGED. Verses 9, 14, 19, 24 and 30 start at x 720 while every other line starts at x 630-640 — a consistent 90px indent, measured line by line across the whole sheet. Each is a stanza opening in the sutta, so each carries para_start. Nothing else on the page is indented.

PAGE 82's VERSE 5 OPENS A STANZA TOO AND IS NOT MARKED, because THAT page does not indent it. Measured on IMG_0346: verses 1 to 6 of this chant all start at x 690-700 with no indent anywhere, where this page indents every stanza opening by 90px. So the book marks its stanzas on page 83 and not on page 82, and each page is reproduced as it prints. Recorded because the grouping now looks uneven in the data and that unevenness is the book's, not an omission.

THE 'THIS TOO IS AN EXCELLENT JEWEL' LINE IS POINTED UNEVENLY. Verse 12 ends อิทัมปิ พุทเธ ระตะนัง ปะณีตัง. WITH a full stop; verses 17, 22 and 28, which are the same line for the Dhamma and the Saṅgha, end ปะณีตัง with none. Read at 2.4x on each. Reproduced exactly as printed on all four.

A WIDE GAP AFTER เต, between it and ทักขิเณยยา, visibly wider than the other word spaces on that line. Read as JUSTIFICATION rather than meaningful spacing and set as a single space, the same decision as page 82's ทะสะ gap. Worth an eye at the book, since the standing rule elsewhere is to reproduce unusual spacing.

THE REFRAIN เอเตนะ สัจเจนะ สุวัตถิ โหตุ. CLOSES FOUR STANZAS on this sheet — verses 13, 18, 23 and 29 — word for word identical every time, and a fifth instance is already in from page 82. Not a duplication: it is the act of truth the whole sutta is built on, repeated after every jewel named. Recorded because check_render walks strings in printed order and a verbatim repeat is exactly the case that reads as a fault.
สัก์ยะมุนี carries the ก์ cluster mark, romanised sakyamunī with the mark dropped — the same treatment the app gives สัก์ยะปุตโต on page 66.

THE CHANT CONTINUES PAST THIS SHEET and the entry says so with continues: true ALONGSIDE continuation_of. Both keys are needed on a chant that arrives in the middle and leaves in the middle: continuation_of tells stage 2 where to append, and continues tells it to leave the ‼ CONTINUES marker in place. Without the second the marker comes off and a sutta that is two-thirds entered reads as finished. Verse 33 ends ภุญชะมานา, a whole printed line, so there is no […] — which is exactly why the cut-line check cannot catch this.

batch_status.notes: ONE CHANT, ONE SHEET, TWENTY-SIX LINES, and the cleanest page in a while — no blocks, no footnote, no colophon, no column change. Three things for Josh. (1) ทัฬ์เหนะ AT VERSE 30 IS THE FIRST READING IN THIS RUN DECIDED BY SOMETHING OTHER THAN THE IMAGE. It is the marked-ฬ configuration page 76 proved unreadable, so it was settled on page 79's cluster test — พ์ห is not legal Pali and gives a non-word — rather than on what the photograph shows. Flagged prominently; every marked ฬ์ from here on needs the book. Each page is reproduced as it prints, so the grouping looks uneven in the data and that unevenness is the book's. (3) VERSE 12 TAKES A FULL STOP that its three parallel lines at 17, 22 and 28 do not.
